name: Historic Centre of Vienna
description: Vienna's old core, on the Danube in northeastern Austria, grew from a Roman camp into the seat of the Habsburg emperors. Today you can walk from medieval lanes to Baroque palaces and gardens, then along the Ringstrasse, a 19th-century boulevard lined with grand buildings and parks. It was also a great musical capital, from Viennese Classicism into the early 1900s.
